title: Chapter 365 The Patriarch Is A Real Man
content:
Chapter 365 The Patriarch Is A Real Man

After the death of this powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan, Lu Daosheng shrugged faintly as if he had done something very ordinary.

At this time, Lu Daosheng suddenly looked in another direction.

"Ha, there are actually some."

"Well, then we'll solve it together."

After saying that, Lu Daosheng disappeared from the spot again.

Chaos Realm.

Blood Domain.

This is one of the strong clans in the Chaos Realm and the base camp of the Divine Blood Clan.

The Divine Blood Clan has risen strongly in a very early era and surpassed the clans. Although the historical heritage is not as long as the human race, it can still rank in the top few.

But at this moment, the clan was filled with worry.

"Is there any news?"

In a dark red hall full of the solemn smell of blood, a sound of vicissitudes that seemed to have come from the years.

The next moment, a powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan slowly walked from a distance.

"Class leader, my seniors have received the news and must be on the way back."

The powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan bowed his head slightly and spoke respectfully.

Hearing this, another sound came from the hall.

This sound is much easier than the last time.

"That's great."

"From the current situation, the supreme law of the Chaos Realm seems to have weakened a lot. After all, there has been almost never been a situation in history where strong people outside the Chaos Realm can forcefully enter."

"What we are comparing now is not only the power of the various races in the Chaos Realm, but also the foundation of the various races in the Chaos Realm."

As soon as these words came out, the powerful Divine Blood Clan outside the hall had already smiled.

"Class leader, as you say, my God Blood Clan will definitely be one of the strong clans in the Chaos Realm. After all, with the foundation of my God Blood Clan, there are few opponents."

However, as soon as the words fell, a blood light shot downward in the direction of the blood domain at an indescribable speed.

Seeing this scene, the bloody realm was facing a great enemy.

Seeing this, the powerful Divine Blood Clan outside the hall was about to stop him, but the hall whispered loudly: "Stop!"

Hearing this, the powerful Divine Blood Clan who had already gathered his power in his hands stopped quickly.

"Class leader?"

He looked puzzled.

But when he looked at the blood light again, his face changed.

It is the breath of his divine blood clan.

Could it be that it was the message sent back by the seniors of our clan?

Thinking of this in his heart, his heart breathed a sigh of relief.

boom!

With a loud bang, a huge sinkhole suddenly appeared in the blood domain.

"Class leader wait, I'll get it for you."

The powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan bowed his hand and then hurried towards the location of the sky pit.

The smoke of gunpowder dissipates.

For some reason, the bloody smell in the entire blood domain seemed to be much more serious again.

The powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan became much more uneasy when he walked to the sinkhole.

Why am I so uneasy?

Forcefully suppressed the doubts in his heart, and he hurried into the sinkhole.

But when he saw the things in the sinkhole clearly, his face turned pale in an instant.

In the sinkhole, the head of a powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan stood there quietly.

The blood-covered eyes were wide open, staring at the front with a close eye.

This is the predecessor of their divine blood clan!

......

"Clan, patriarch...."

The powerful man from the Divine Blood Clan held the heads of their Divine Blood Clan seniors in his hand and walked back to the outside of the hall.

The hall was calm for a moment.

The next moment, the sound of footsteps rang out.

A figure wearing a blood robe and majestic face slowly emerged from the darkness.

At this moment, his face was extremely cold.

Buzz —

Space trembles.

Several more powerful people from the Divine Blood Clan appeared.

"Class leader."

At this moment, all the powerful men of the Divine Blood Clan were staring at their patriarch.

The future of the God Blood Clan is closely grasped in his hands.

The leader of the Divine Blood Clan pondered for a moment and slowly closed his eyes.

"From this moment, my divine blood clan and the human clan will never end."

.........

The same situation occurred in the other major powerful tribes.

Without exception, all races were angry about this.

"My God Clan and the human Clan will never end."

"The same is true for my divine power clan."

In the Chaos Realm, since the decline of the human race, only six powerful races remain.

They are the Heavenly God Clan, the Shadow Clan, the Divine Power Clan, the Holy Spirit Clan, the Heavenly Demon Clan, and the Divine Blood Clan.

After this incident, half of the six powerful clans completely broke with the human race.

Of course, from the moment they attacked the human race, the human race had already been with them forever.

In addition to these three tribes, the Shadow Clan, one of the six powerful tribes, also attacked the human race at that time.

This tribe is very special, and the tribe is pitifully few, and I'm afraid there is not even one percent of these strong tribes.

But the Shadow Clan is still among the strong clans, relying on this clan's control over the way of space.

Looking at the Shadow Clan's use of the Way of Space, no opponent can match the entire Chaos Realm.

The reason why the human race was defeated so quickly was because the Shadow Clan's strong men secretly helped and broke through one defensive barrier after another of the human race.

But until now, the Shadow Clan still did nothing, which made the other tribes puzzled.

Inside the Shadow Clan.

The atmosphere also seemed extremely depressing.

"Class leader, what should I do? We seem to be kicking the iron plate?"

"Class leader, why don't we run away? Let's keep the green mountains there, and we won't be afraid of burning firewood."

"Dad, I didn't agree with you to get involved in this matter at that time. Now, I've gotten into trouble with the great enemy of the human race."

The voices within the clan were surprisingly consistent, all of them were anti-war factions.

In the middle of the ethnic group, a middle-aged man with an illusion and a blue face lowered his head and pondered.

He also regretted it at this moment.

When the three tribes invited him to attack the human race, he was unwilling to go.

After all, their Shadow Clan uses the word "gou".

It depends entirely on being able to survive until now.

Taking the initiative is not in line with their Shadow Clan's style.

But thinking that he was the patriarch and had been in office for many years and did nothing, he could not help but hear the big cakes painted by the three tribes.

"Okay, I've done it!"

"I will create the brilliant future of the Shadow Clan."

"Captain, we believe in you!"

"Captain, let go and do it. Behind you, there will always be a group of loyal tribe members."

"Dad, I'm proud of you."

Thinking about it now, damn it, I was fooled.

Looking at the patriarch's eager gaze around him, he sighed heavily, "What else can I do now? I can't really let me kneel down."

"It's not impossible."

"Class leader, I'm optimistic about you."

"Dad, you said that a man has gold under his knees, and it is time to cash in! "

The shadow clan leader's face turned pale.

"I am one of the six powerful clans in the Chaos Realm, the leader of the Shadow Clan. You ask me to kneel down just to survive? Ah?"

"I tell you, even if I was beaten to death by the human race, and jumped out of the endless abyss, I would never kneel down!!!"

The powerful voice of the head of the Shadow Clan was endless from the Shadow Clan.

A moment later, a message that shocked the Chaos Realm instantly spread throughout the Chaos Realm at an astonishing speed.

One of the six powerful clans, the leader of the Shadow Clan, was the first to kneel down to beg for mercy to the human race in front of everyone!
